t: Before you go on — when you say the jury decides, do you mean they decide guilt, or do they also decide the sentence?
Right. So in your system the defense is a public body, not a firm the family chooses. That changes what I was about to ask.
Here is my difficulty. You have argued that the delay explains the inconsistencies. But if the delay explains them, it explains them for both sides — so why does it help you and not the prosecution?
